entry.title: Książ Castle and park complex

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Inspected aerial picture confirms coral-pink Baroque entrance wing, tall domed central tower, paired western roof towers, buff stone ranges and stepped garden terraces. Retained mapped castle/court rings and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and entrance-facing orientation. The derivative reconstructs a working court at Y5, keeps terrace tops above coarse ground and moves the separate Powder Tower to its retained mapped position at native [88.89756493084487,47.64031319972397] with a coarse-ground footing. This review covers the castle/terrace model; separately modeled park buildings retain their own QA status. Anchor 16.291558848,50.842218729; heading 0.487948990682; standard PMTiles datum 392.7276846126304m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
